author: Davidgo5867

english.text: As has already been said, the Third Men were prone to phases of preoccupation with the ancient craving for personal immortality. This craving had often been strong among the First Men; and even the Second Men, in spite of their great gift of detachment, had sometimes allowed their admiration for human personality to persuade them that souls must live for ever. The short-lived and untheoretical Third Men, with their passion for living things of all kinds, and all the diversity of vital behaviour, conceived immortality in a variety of manners. In their final culture they imagined that at death all living things whom the Life God approved passed into another world, much like the familiar world, but happier. There they were said to live in the presence of the deity, serving him in untrammelled vital creativeness of sundry kinds.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Today's the 9th of May of 2025. All day has been grey skies. After morning Iced Coffee with oat milk at Tim Hortons café, I went walking towards the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road, just so I could pass by the big tree that looks like a jacaranda tree with purple blooms, but isn't a jacaranda. (The species remind me of South America.) More of the brick-like impressions on the pedestrian have been painted white, not red as I would imagine. Lulu Islanders aren't so fanciful with colours, unlike Vancouver or other cities. I went to the major worship hall, again to admire the fancy colourful stained glass. The crucifix is adorned with white fabric. At the smaller Adoration Chapel, I began to notice on the right front the Virgin Mary statue with the Child statue on her side. In the evening, I returned to the café to enjoy a Green Tea with oat milk, a Blackberry Yuzu Lemonade Quencher, and a Roast Beef Craveable Sandwich. At home, I amused myself with Korean grammar, which was a slight distraction to my core studies of Esperanto and Lojban. With StreetView, I started looking again at the streets in South Korea. Maybe, I will try more of the countryside, as I have done with Thailand. For lunch and dinner at home was noodle dishes.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 9 hou6。cyun4 jat6 dou1 hai6 fui1 sik1 ge3 tin1 hung1。hai2 Tim Hortons café sik6 jyun4 ziu1 zou2 ge3 Iced Coffee gaa1 jin3 mak6 naai5 zi1 hau6，ngo5 zau6 haang4 heoi3 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2，zi2 hai6 wai6 zo2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 ging1 gwo3 go2 fo2 daai6 syu6，ni1 po1 daai6 syu6 hou2 ci5 jat1 fo2 jau5 zi2 sik1 faa1 do2 ge3 laam4 faa1 jing4 syu6，daan6 m4 hai6 laam4 faa1 jing4（ni1 zung2 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2 naam4 mei5 zau1。）deoi3 hang4 jan4 lai4 gong2 ge3 jan3 zoeng6 hai6 zyun1 tau4 gam2 waak6 zo2 baak6 sik1，m4 hai6 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 jap6 min6 ge3 hung4 sik1，lou6 lou6 dou2 jan4 deoi3 ngaan4 sik1 mou5 gam3 kei4 waan6，m4 ci5 wan1 go1 waa4 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 sing4 si5，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 zyu2 jiu3 ge3 sung4 baai3 tong4，zoi3 ci3 jan1 soeng2 go2 di1 faa1 sik1 ge3 coi2 sik1 coi2 sik1 bo1 lei1。sap6 zi6 gaa2 hai6 jung6 baak6 sik1 ge3 bou3 liu2 zong1 sik1。hai2 gaau3 sai3 ge3 sung4 baai3 gaau3 tong2，ngo5 hoi1 ci2 lau4 ji3 dou3 jau6 bin6 cin4 min6 jau5 go3 sing3 mou5 maa5 lei6 aa3 diu1 zoeng6，ji4 go3 ji4 tung4 diu1 zoeng6 hai2 keoi5 zak1 bin1。je6 maan5，ngo5 faan2 zo2 heoi3 gaa3 fe1 teng1，jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 luk6 caa4 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5，jat1 bui1 hak1 mui2 jau2 zi2 ning4 mung1 seoi2 ceoi3 fo2，tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 siu1 ngau4 hou2 mei6 ge3 saam1 man4 zi6。hai2 uk1 kei2，ngo5 jung6 hon4 man2 man4 faat3 lai4 waan2 lok6，ni1 go3 deoi3 ngo5 deoi3 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 tung4 lok3 ji1 baan1 jyu5 ge3 hat6 sam1 jin4 gau3 jau5 siu2 siu2 fan1 saan2 zyu3 ji3 lik6。jau5 zo2 gaai1 ging2，ngo5 zau6 hoi1 ci2 cung4 san1 tai2 haa2 hon4 gwok3 ge3 gaai1 dou6。ho2 nang4，ngo5 wui6 si5 do1 di1 hoeng1 haa2，zau6 hou2 ci5 ngo5 tung4 taai3 gwok3 zou6 gwo3 ge3 je5 gam2。hai2 uk1 kei2 ge3 ng5 caan1 tung4 maan5 caan1 dou1 hai6 min6 sik6。
text: 今日係2025年5月9號。全日都係灰色嘅天空。喺 Tim Hortons café 食完朝早嘅 Iced Coffee 加燕麥奶之後，我就行去聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂，只係為咗我可以經過嗰棵大樹，呢棵大樹好似一棵有紫色花朵嘅藍花楹樹，但唔係藍花楹（呢種令我諗起南美洲。）對行人嚟講嘅印象係磚頭噉畫咗白色，唔係我想像入面嘅紅色，露露島人對顏色冇咁奇幻，唔似溫哥華或者其他城市，我去咗主要嘅崇拜堂，再次欣賞嗰啲花式嘅彩色彩色玻璃。十字架係用白色嘅布料裝飾。喺較細嘅崇拜教堂，我開始留意到右邊前面有個聖母瑪利亞雕像，而個兒童雕像喺佢側邊。夜晚，我返咗去咖啡廳，飲咗一杯綠茶配燕麥奶，一杯黑莓柚子檸檬水淬火，同埋一個燒牛好味嘅三文治。喺屋企，我用韓文文法嚟玩樂，呢個對我對世界語同洛伊班語嘅核心研究有少少分散注意力。有咗街景，我就開始重新睇吓韓國嘅街道。可能，我會試多啲鄉下，就好似我同泰國做過嘅嘢噉。喺屋企嘅午餐同晚餐都係麵食。
